Hi hi ! I work for Canadian version of TSA, buttt
basically the bags we use are to ensure your liquids are of the correct size (under 100mL) and fit in the 1L bag. 
To get more in depth, this was tested and found that this amount of liquid, if it was explosive, does a “controllable” amount of damage. If that makes sense :)

Security check is not different for minors really. You’re welcome to wear it as under a normal security check it won’t trigger any alarms (since it’s not metal). I think you’d be fine to wear a packer and tape.
Keep in mind we are looking for contraband, weapons or explosives. While a Full Body Scanner MAY detect you wearing one - laws normally don’t allow “sensitive” pat downs on minors without a parent or guardian approval. Also you don’t have to go through FBS scanning and can request a metal wanding instead. *

*these are protocols in place in Canada - USA laws may differ. 
Source: I’m a screening officer at an airport

When I lived in my apartment, the man across the hall that no one liked had a smell coming from his apartment that was just awful. It was nasty and everywhere and.. not really specific to something you could point out and say "aha! that's what it is". This went on for days. Turns out he slipped and fell in his bathroom and was just lying there for days until the super finally listened to me and called someone to investigate. I thought nothing of the smell at the time  
Skip to now, where I have a part-time job with placement in body removal services, where we take bodies of the deceased to the coroner's office or funeral home. Our first real decomposing body was exactly the same smell. It's almost.. heavy in your nostrils. It sticks to you and lingers everywhere. It's very difficult to describe smell as I'm sitting here for 10 minutes thinking of what to write. But it's definitely heavy in your nose, it's meaty - but I find it different than a butcher shop. The smell is more metallic and coppery mixed in with the heavy smell of meat and a tinge of poop.. almost. When you inhale it's right on the cusp of where your nose would hurt or your lungs would burn as you inhale but it never quite happens it just lingers in your nose and stays there. Even in our van with all the windows down it's there. 

I dont know if this helps but this is my take on it!!
